feature: Visual companion home and persistent castle interiors
scope: Companion homepage shows saved territory and room
12 craftable furniture types with four Higgsfield views each
3 wall and floor finishes; three rooms unlocked by existing castle expansion
Drag, touch placement, rotate, layering, tabletop support, store, undo/redo, save/cancel
Resident uses furniture; existing score, companion and territory records retained
data: Optional homeDecor field; explicit one-time starter furnishings, server-priced crafting, base revision check, existing account authorization/receipts/locks; imported homeDecor discarded

checks.productionRetry: First automated attempt timed out waiting for an open-room command response during initial loading. The same isolated QA account passed the full workflow after waiting for initial assets and network readiness.

limitations: Browser QA uses isolated new account and touch emulation, not physical devices
Room furniture uses four rendered views on a 2D scene, not a 3D free camera
No claim that interface increases real learning motivation
